sn55.45:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako “aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo mahāyaso”ti vuccati.
sn55.45:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.45:2.3: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.45:2.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.45:2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako “aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo mahāyaso”ti vuccatīti.
